actionlint: not installed; only YAML parsing and bounded structural checks performed

llm.rationale: The pattern P-LIT-SELECT (test selection via change dependencies) is implemented by identifying changed Elixir files using git diff and passing them to the mix test command. This follows the mechanism of selecting tests based on change dependencies. To ensure the workflow remains robust and follows the instruction to preserve all original commands, the logic falls back to a full test run if no relevant files are changed. Caching is added for the Docker layer/build context where possible, but since the primary dependency is managed via Dockerfile, the focus is on the test selection logic as requested by the pattern.

semantic_preservation: human and change-specific behavior review required
